title: Complete e2e FLA read/write compatibility with Flash 8 based on spec 21
description: Renumbered off a duplicate 1201 id (concurrent-pusher counter collision; original was empty-description). Implement full end-to-end FLA read AND write round-trip compatibility with real Flash 8 per docs/21-fla-binary-format.md, validated by carchive-validate.ts and the real fixtures (Magnet.fla, evaporatingdrip.fla, flash8-empty.fla). See CLAUDE.md 'Binary FLA writer' learnings.
